verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a shared inbox where every conversation stays visible so the team can collaborate in real time and step in without losing context. It also documents IVR routing that sends callers to the right team, which implies several teammates working behind shared lines. Presence appears only indirectly, through a developer tutorial for building an availability tracker, which counts as a building block rather than a product feature. Missing for 10: explicit shared-number configuration, a documented first-party presence/availability feature, conversation assignment to specific teammates, internal threads or notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
